brief: Rain leaves no trace. `rainFall` drives drops, an overcast tint, pond rings and sparkle; the moment it stops the plaza, quay and cross street are dry. Add a `wetness` 0..1 world scalar (rate-capped: rises with `rainFall`, dries with daylight and warmth, slower in winter) and make the PAVED ground read it — `pavingAt(x,y)` cells in `groundBase`/`drawGround` darken and cool by wetness, and after dark the night screen pass lays lamp reflections on wet paving the way `drawRiverLights` lays them on water (a faint bar under each lamp, × wetness × nightF). The cached ground layer must not repaint every frame for this: bucket wetness the way the light bucket is bucketed, count rebuilds.
successLooksLike: A seed-pinned plaza crop an hour after a summer shower ends is visibly darker than HEAD and dries back to byte-identical within ~3 sim hours; a night crop after rain shows a lamp bar on the plaza and quay paving; `probes/ground-rebuilds.mjs` within +20/day of #56's 137/130; `frame-cost.mjs` within 0.5 ms of HEAD; census unchanged (draw-only).
avoid: Do not wet grass, beds or the allotments — paving only, so the town's places read differently from its ground. Do not add an R() draw. Do not give people umbrellas twice or change any behaviour: this is the ground, not the walkers.
